scope: All 31 G1V2 candidate labels; exact nearest rows read, not exhaustive absence over the archive. Parent batch cross-links still pending. Physical images front/back not fully audited.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Number words and tens/ones are covered. Following crossing curved connector lines is not exercised by a word-only bundled-stick example.
candidates.next_action: Merge with existing G1 spatial asset queue; do not claim line tracing from text.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: A labelled numeric filter followed by sorting is present in grade 4. G1 colour-filtered max/min needs an age-appropriate representation; a larger-grade filter is not full G1 coverage.
candidates.next_action: Cross-check root conjunctive numeral filter and original typed attribute cases before authoring.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Existing G1 row reads an already complete date/weekday table. Inferring another date or weekday from a single anchor requires counting the offset and is not identical to lookup.
candidates.next_action: Queue bounded G1 anchor-and-offset cases; do not use current real-world date.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Reading explicitly described hands and matching to an activity is covered. Image recognition, rotated faces and locating the highest clock are not validated by these text examples.
candidates.next_action: Retain clock semantics; queue original clock diagram metadata/assets and review.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Existing source compares supplied cm values. It does not teach counting equally spaced grid units or aligning differently oriented strips to a common reference.
candidates.next_action: Merge grid/length spatial queue; specify unit intervals and endpoints in original data.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Shape-name matching and independent-symbol counting exist separately. Counting each component of a composite robot by shape requires an explicit component inventory or image.
candidates.next_action: Merge composite shape inventory queue; avoid assuming hidden components.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: A 2 by 2 subdivision includes a larger square as well as the unit squares. Independent-dot counting does not teach exhaustive composite-square enumeration.
candidates.next_action: Merge G3/G4 composite geometry candidate; original edge/grid description must state all boundaries.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Existing G1 sequence has a declared step of one. Declared steps of two, five or ten need explicit repeated-step examples and are not proven by sorting.
candidates.next_action: Check skip-count train rows across grades; add only an uncovered G1 representation.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Reading known ruler endpoints is covered. Measuring a printed object in cm cannot be inferred from an arbitrarily resized page image.
candidates.next_action: Queue original calibrated assets or ask for actual ruler/measurement; no numeric length from screenshot pixels.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Sorting distinct numbers does not assign a multiset with repeated scores to named people under a strict comparison. P89 requires preserving both equal high scores.
candidates.next_action: Candidate for bounded multiset constraint cases after comparison with root global-card assignment.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Grade 3 elapsed minutes is covered. The G1 task should count whole-hour intervals between explicit same-day endpoints without importing minute arithmetic.
candidates.next_action: Queue G1 age-appropriate whole-hour elapsed cases; distinguish midnight/day ambiguity.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Mass equality on a balanced scale exists in grade 2. G1 equal abstract quantities on both sides are a different representation; no unit-free physical mass assumption.
candidates.next_action: Merge balance relation queue; represent each side explicitly and keep units appropriate.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Existing path has a unary predicate at every node. P93 uses one gate from each of two stages and a relation between the two labels, so a per-node filter alone is insufficient.
candidates.next_action: Queue original finite two-layer graph and enumerate all legal gate pairs.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Independent-dot count and restoring two triangles do not cover exhaustive unit-square count in a nonrectangular region.
candidates.next_action: Merge grid-region queue; define occupied cells explicitly.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: A linear sequence of adding then removing is covered. Branches or shared intermediate nodes, if required, need their actual graph. P97 is a linear arrow representation of the same arithmetic.
candidates.next_action: Treat P97 linear chain as covered semantics with arrow representation; inspect P51 graph separately before claiming a missing relation.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: General shape identification does not define a seven-segment numeral or count required segments for every allowed numeral.
candidates.next_action: Merge seven-segment digit queue with explicit segment sets; no inferred match lengths.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Existing G1 rows cover a single missing digit and a nonunique multi-blank guard. P98 includes jointly determined blanks. Root grade 4 multi-blank batch is related but does not establish G1 instructional fit.
candidates.next_action: Cross-link root multi-blank accepted hashes and review a G1 no-borrow version before additional authoring.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Weekday lookup and a fixed queue exist separately; mapping successive itinerary stops to successive weekdays needs an explicit start and one-stop-per-day rule.
candidates.next_action: Queue after checking ordinal/day mapping cases; preserve missing-rule guards.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Existing guard correctly avoids inventing a measurement for an unseen personal object. Selecting a plausible scale from supplied options is a different task and must not turn typical size into guaranteed personal measurement.
candidates.next_action: Use original explicit reference ranges/options, or keep as a guard; no universal exact desk/handspan dimensions.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: An explicit directed graph with a numeric predicate is covered in accepted G1 source. The SGK picture itself is not a missing numeric method.
candidates.next_action: Keep source coverage and queue only original diagram representation if needed.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Restoring two cut pieces is not deleting edges and recounting all triangles in a shared-edge arrangement.
candidates.next_action: Merge finite edge-deletion geometry queue; specify edge set and count larger triangles too.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Reading tens/ones does not itself select all numbers whose two digit symbols are equal. A finite predicate over an explicitly given list is needed.
candidates.next_action: Cross-check root conjunctive numeral filter and G1 card list cases before new rows.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Known-result column completion and sorting cards into value bins do not construct equations taking each operand/result from different supplied pools.
candidates.next_action: Cross-link G1 new number-card equations and root global assignment; add only uncovered role-pool constraint.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Adding one route and comparing two known lengths are covered separately. Choosing between different explicitly enumerated routes combines them and must retain edge connectivity.
candidates.next_action: Merge route comparison queue; check existing shortest-path exact rows first.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Matching exact start time to a clock is covered; filtering events by whether arrival is before start requires a strict/inclusive eligibility rule.
candidates.next_action: Queue original same-day whole-hour schedule with equality boundary explicit.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Swapping entire digit cards preserves each digit shape. Moving one segment changes digit shapes and needs an allowed seven-segment alphabet; it is not the same operation.
candidates.next_action: Merge G2/G3/G4 single-match candidates with one explicit finite oracle and legal operator rule.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Sorting and repairing an equation via one digit swap are present separately. Repairing the order with exactly one positional swap is a constrained operation.
candidates.next_action: Cross-link root minimum-swap rows; review G1 no-cycle-language version rather than duplicate a family.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: P89 lotus stages require botanical stage recognition from pictures. Fixed queue order only follows a stated order and does not establish biological world knowledge.
candidates.next_action: Do not manufacture a math gap or certainty from this page; use stated sequence relations for any original temporal-order task.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Accepted G1 source matches both weekday and hour; calendar row reads paired data in either direction. These cover the core table lookup relation. A pictured timetable layout still needs representation evidence.
candidates.next_action: No extra semantic family for basic day/hour lookup; split elapsed-time and arrival-eligibility extensions into their own candidates.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Sequential changes to one container do not directly cover transfer changing two groups in opposite directions before comparison. P89 has a tie boundary.
candidates.next_action: Queue original two-group transfer with conservation and post-transfer comparison; compare with root G1 add-group strict cases first.

candidates.semantic_adjudication: Tens/ones composition from a specified quantity does not enumerate all ordered choices of two distinct physical cards, with zero forbidden in the tens position.
candidates.next_action: Merge G2 two-digit-card candidate; define card reuse and zero rule, independently enumerate all choices.
